checkedAlternates.risk: The tumble-dry symbol also features a circle.
checkedAlternates.resolution: A standalone circle represents professional dry cleaning (group-1), whereas a circle inscribed inside a square denotes tumble drying (group-4).

checkedAlternates.risk: Ironing dots use the same 1/2/3-dot scale as tumble-dry heat.
checkedAlternates.resolution: The iron silhouette specifically governs pressing/ironing temperature (group-3), not washing or drying (group-4).
